In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a '''battle''' was fought between a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] band, the [[Solar Terrors]], and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] the ''[[Far Orbit]]''. In the end, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dhas Fenoep Vedij]] and the privateers defeated the pirates.
